interpretation: The frozen 32 additions passed the preregistered fitting-only point-estimate advancement rule on this 1,024-session cohort.

The paired 95% bootstrap gain interval includes zero, so this is not independent proof of a stable ranking lift and does not authorize promotion or selection access.
